The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a '''listening outpost''' at the [[Rhen Var Citadel]]. It was [[Attack on Rhen Var|taken over]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] but was destroyed in the Imperial [[Sabotage at Rhen Var|counter-attack]].
